title: docs(pm): grade in a fixed order with decidable tests for security boundary, core task, workaround and real-user reach
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoUpipVscs9RhepMcHqdy7V1)_

Fixes #32997

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 2026-11-13 定级裁定的九条规则写进 `filing-gate.md`〈定级判据〉（旧「重点功能上调一档」并入第 8 条，旧「可达面定上界」并入第 2 条）；北极星〈Priority〉按裁定改三处：数据静默错或丢为 p1（受降档约束）、挡路的流程或工具卡为 p2 带 `pm:blocking` 不沿链继承、定级规则本身改变时允许一次重定级。
- 为什么改：裁定只引在卡上，受管参考与北极星仍是 #32906 的旧措辞，席位首触定级照旧规则走。
- 风险与回滚：只改内部协议文字与北极星两句，无代码；`filing-gate.md` 行数上限 67 → 79，按 2026-10-15 B 条（记录 6184799323）由本裁定授权，实测增量 +12。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` Priority 第 2、3 条；`filing-gate.md` 第 46–59 行（九条规则）；`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` filing-gate 行的抬高注释。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs | grep filing-gate`，预期 `79 lines (ceiling 79; headroom 0)` 且退出 0。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`）。契约复审在现 head 已 PASS（r1 评论 6850144637 FAIL，r2 增量 6851246588 PASS，Head-sha `ed888e80e61d7283b30e9abd4d43e2760a1a25d8`），请以 os-zhuang 批准；本 PR 无 changeset，冻结期间可落地。另有三点请您定夺（本 PR 不改）：① 北极星「The one measure: the road」段仍写「跑通但结果错为 P2」，与新 Priority 第 2 条「数据静默错或丢为 P1」不一致，是否同改？② Priority 第 3 条前半「车道有未派 P0/P1 时不派 p2/p3 工具卡」现在也会挡住为其解锁的 p2 `pm:blocking` 工具卡，是否豁免？③ 第 3 条「无证据上限」按分诊的读法不取消 `reach:` 的收卡门槛（缺 `reach:` 仍先定 p3，实测或点名生产者后按影响重定）；如不同意请指出。
- 席位意见：同意落地。九条与北极星三处逐条对过卡上原话；r1 的 must-fix（误删 p3 行「真实用户可撞 ⇒ p2」使升档无落点）已在 r2 恢复，should-fix 由分诊在卡上给出读法后关闭；余 nit 作为接受的偏差。

## What changes

- **`filing-gate.md` 〈定级判据〉.** The impact rows stay; the p2 row now names a blocking process or tooling card as p2 with `pm:blocking` and no chain inheritance, and the p3 row keeps its "real user can hit ⇒ p2" landing grade, which rule 7 defines. The nine adopted rules follow as a numbered list: order, reach discount (no second step for "no current user"), no evidence cap, security boundary, core task, workaround, a real user can hit, the MCP focus raise (pointing at `lanes/triage.md` for the focus list), and checklist assertion defects at p2. Rule 9 quotes the maintainer's 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」. Two lines are deleted as superseded: 「重点功能…上调一档」 (rule 8) and 「可达面定上界…」 (rule 2; its 「`security` 标签不抬级」 half is now rule 4).
- **`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈Priority〉, exactly the three ruled changes.** Rule 2: data silently wrong or lost ⇒ P1, subject to the reach discount, other wrong-running stays P2; ⛔ never re-grade card by card, except one pass when the grading rules change. Rule 3: the chain-inheritance clause becomes "a process or tooling card that blocks other work is P2 and carries `pm:blocking`; it does not inherit priority up the chain". Nothing else moves.
- **`lanes/triage.md` is unchanged.** Its only grading line is already a pointer (「定级见 `filing-gate.md`」) and its MCP focus line is the list rule 8 points to, so no rule is stated twice.
- **Ruled raise.** `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `filing-gate.md` CEILINGS row moves 67 → 79. Authority: ratchet letter B (ruling 2026-10-15, record 6184799323), the ruling of record being the maintainer's 2026-11-13 grading ruling quoted verbatim in the #32997 body (「只是读代码得出的最高 p2。这个没必要吧，我们的客户不多。」, 「不需要限额，也不需要自动关。其他同意。」; triage audit 6846766675). Measured delta +12: the nine rules take 14 lines under the 120-byte line cap, and 2 lines are deleted. The seat added this path to the claim's file surface (amendment 6849221818).

## Tests

Protocol text and one ceiling constant; no tested behaviour changed, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Sweep (references, `AGENTS.md`, north star) for "every protocol addition is p1", a code-read evidence cap, or a "no current user" discount: the only hit was the retired 「可达面定上界」 line, removed here. Swept and kept: `filing-gate.md`'s `finding` admission line (one MEASURED wrong result at a public entry or a named real producer) and `triage-duties.md` 「缺 `reach:` 且非例外 ⇒ 定 `priority:p3`」. The card's filer (triage) answered on the card (6850654783) that `reach:` stays the admission test and rule 3 grades findings past it. Nothing grades every protocol addition p1 (release-required ones are p1, ordinary ones p2, as before).
- Left for the seat, outside the file surface: `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` "The one measure: the road" still says a step "that runs through but gives a wrong result is P2" (the order keeps the rest of the north star fixed); `lanes/triage.md` 「有公开卡只定 `security`+p1」 fixes a grade for public security cards beside rule 4 (a line-neutral rewording does not fit the 120-byte cap); north star rule 3's first half holds back p2/p3 tooling cards while a lane has an open P0/P1, which now also reaches a p2 blocking tooling card.

- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, `filing-gate.md is 79 lines (ceiling 79; headroom 0)`; `--self-test`: 164 cases pass. Every line of the edited section is within the 120-byte cap.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`: each exit 0.
- lint `check:doc-formula-expressions`: first run exit 3 (prerequisite, lint dist not built); after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0.
